mapper.select: select 'RQ' as code, '신청완료' as name, sum(cnt) as count from ( select count(*) as cnt from nwchg where proc_cd = 'RQ' union all select count(*) as cnt from svchg where proc_cd = 'RQ' union all select count(*) as cnt from nmchg where proc_cd = 'RQ' union all select count(*) as cnt from svcnl where proc_cd = 'RQ' ) union all select 'CP' as code, '처리완료' as name, sum(cnt) as count from ( select count(*) as cnt from nwchg where proc_cd = 'CP' union all select count(*) as cnt from svchg where proc_cd = 'CP' union all select count(*) as cnt from nmchg where proc_cd = 'CP' union all select count(*) as cnt from svcnl where proc_cd = 'CP' ) union all select 'BK' as code, '신청취소' as name, sum(cnt) as count from ( select count(*) as cnt from nwchg where proc_cd = 'BK' union all select count(*) as cnt from svchg where proc_cd = 'BK' union all select count(*) as cnt from nmchg where proc_cd = 'BK' union all select count(*) as cnt from svcnl where proc_cd = 'BK' )

select a.code, b.dtl_cd_nm as name, a.count from ( select '1' as code, count(*) as count from nwchg union all select '2' as code, count(*) as count from svchg union all select '3' as code, count(*) as count from nmchg union all select '4' as code, count(*) as count from svcnl ) a , msf_cd_dtl b where a.code = b.dtl_cd and b.cd_group_id = 'FORM_TYPE_CD' order by a.code
mapper.sql:
where board_ctg_cd = 'NOTI' and view_yn = 'Y' and to_char(current_timestamp, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') between start_date and end_date
and sbst_ctg_cd = #{category}
and board_write_dt >= to_timestamp(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS')
and board_write_dt <= to_timestamp(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59.999', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS')
and ( board_title ilike concat('%', #{value}, '%') or board_contents_sbst ilike concat('%', #{value}, '%') )
mapper.select:
select board_seq , board_ctg_cd , sbst_ctg_cd , sbst_sub_ctg_cd , board_title , view_yn , noti_yn , board_contents_sbst , board_writer_id , board_writer_nm , board_write_dt , img_nm , board_att_yn , board_hit_cnt , start_date , end_date from msf_board_bas
order by board_write_dt desc, board_seq desc limit #{page.rowSize} offset #{page.offset}
mapper.sql:
where del_yn != 'Y' and view_yn = 'Y' and ( cret_view_yn = 'Y' or (cret_view_yn != 'Y' and qna_writer_id = #{loginId}) )
and qna_ctg_cd = #{category}
and write_dt >= to_timestamp(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS')
and write_dt <= to_timestamp(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59.999', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS')
and ( qna_title ilike concat('%', #{value}, '%') or qna_content_sbst ilike concat('%', #{value}, '%') )
mapper.select:
select qna_seq , qna_ctg_cd , qna_sub_ctg_cd , qna_title , qna_writer_id , qna_nm , write_dt , qna_content_sbst , ans_title , ans_content_sbst , cret_view_yn , ans_sttus_cd , ans_id , ans_nm , ans_org_id , ans_org_nm , ans_dt , board_hit_cnt from msf_qna_board_bas
order by write_dt desc, qna_seq desc limit #{page.rowSize} offset #{page.offset}
mapper.insert:
select nextval('sq_qna_board_seq'::regclass)
insert into msf_qna_board_bas ( qna_seq, qna_ctg_cd, qna_title, qna_writer_id, qna_nm, write_dt, qna_content_sbst, cret_view_yn, ans_sttus_cd, del_yn, view_yn, board_hit_cnt ) values ( #{qnaSeq}, #{qnaCtgCd}, #{qnaTitle}, #{qnaWriterId}, #{qnaNm}, current_timestamp, #{qnaContentSbst}, #{cretViewYn}, 'R', 'N', 'Y', 0 )
